recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog settling over san francisco at dusk
a webcam theremin turning empty air into music
geometry and gpu code locating a mystery island
privacy-first android finding its way onto motorola phones
late august sun slipping past seven in the bay

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Karl the fog advances in waves — tap to open brief clearings before they seal, revealing rooftop gardens underneath a miniature skyline.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each clearing adds a tile to an SF skyline mosaic that completes in one minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: overlapping fog waves demand double-taps and shrinking clear-window timing

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold and release to shape an invisible theremin antenna — sustain the right pitch to magnetize floating notes into brief chords before they drift away.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: landing a four-note chord triggers a phosphor bloom and resets the score multiplier
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: background hum drifts the target pitch and notes spawn in tighter clusters

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick triangulation buoys into rough seas — when three land on valid geometry points, a pixel of a hidden island resolves on your nautical chart.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: thirty seconds to fully reveal one mystery island silhouette
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: ocean currents curve buoy trajectories and spawn decoy reflection points

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe agent-generated code snippets left to ship, right to iterate, or up to archive before an orange sunrise bleeds through the window.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clean shipping streak fills a dawn gradient score bar in under a minute
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: snippets grow longer and decoy labels appear on ambiguous tasks
